cohort: The study included 542 females with cystic fibrosis (fwCF) from 21 Italian CF centers, encompassing children, adolescents, and adults.
finding: Urinary incontinence affects mostly adult females with cystic fibrosis and is associated with older age and longer hospitalization, while 150 minutes of physical activity per week is associated with a reduced probability of UI.
